comment: Model matrix for the prompt-caching eval. Only providers the app allowlists for explicit cache_control (see OpenRouter.Payload.Utils.cache_control_provider_prefixes: anthropic/, google/, qwen/). Cheapest viable member of each family, plus the production default (Sonnet) for direct relevance. Add entries freely; the harness validates each id against the live /models endpoint before spending anything.

models.why: Cheapest Claude with prompt caching; highest min-cacheable-prefix threshold in the family (2048 tokens), so a pass here derisks the rest.
Production default model in the app; the result we actually care about.
Cheap; already referenced in codebase comments as the model where prompt_tokens over-reporting was measured.
Cheap representative of the third allowlisted explicit-caching family.
